messages:
Lina: Heads-up — putting together a tiny 'paste-ready' manager kit for the upcoming review window. Need one-liners, coaching cues, and a short benefits reminder line for folks who mention capacity/leave.

Ravi: Awesome. Can we keep manager lines <= 2 sentences? Most just copy/paste into reviews.

Lina: Yep. Two-sentence max. Also adding a 1-line self-review starter for ICs who hate writing.

Priya: Please include a line for "what to highlight for cross-team hires" — hiring folks ask for that when writing recommendations.

Lina: Adding. Also adding a friendly HR note mentioning parental, sabbatical, and flexible PTO options for anything capacity-related.

Jules: Tiny nit: can we add a checklist for evidence links (PRs, dashboards, customer quotes)? Makes it easier for managers to paste concrete proof.

Lina: Done — short bulleted checklist. Draft below.

Lina: --- MANAGER KIT: 2-SENTENCE PASTE LINES ---
1) Strength (2 sentences max): "[Name] reliably delivered X by doing Y; this improved Z (metric or outcome)."
2) Area to grow (1 sentence): "To scale impact, I recommend [Name] lead X cross-team initiative or mentor on Y."
3) Follow-up action (1 sentence): "Plan: assign a stretch project in Q3 and pair them with a senior mentor for 3 months."

Lina: --- IC ONE-LINER OPENERS ---
- "Summary: Focus area, main outcome, and a single evidence pointer. e.g., 'Summary: Focused on inference cost reduction; cut GPU-hours/1M requests by 12% (see perf dashboard).'"
- "Quick impact: shipped X, saved Y, next step Z."

Lina: --- CROSS-TEAM HIRE/RECOMMENDATION LINE ---
- "Recommendation: [Name] consistently bridged infra and product, enabling the retention experiment that lifted activation by 3% — recommend for roles owning product-infra integrations."

Lina: --- EVIDENCE CHECKLIST (pasteable) ---
- PRs: #1234, #1299
- Dashboards: perf -> p95_latency, cost -> gpu_hours/1M
- Customer note: support ticket #678 (quote)

Lina: --- BENEFITS/CAPACITY REMINDER (1 line) ---
- "If capacity was limited due to life events, remember to note flexible PTO, parental leave, or the sabbatical policy; People Ops can add context in calibration meetings."

Priya: Love the benefits line. Can we make an optional line managers can add when someone had reduced capacity?

Lina: Sure — optional snippet: "Note: took 8 weeks parental leave (June-July); progress reflects condensed timeline."

Ravi: Can you add a 1-sentence coaching prompt for managers who want to encourage ownership?

Lina: Added: "Coaching prompt: invite them to define a 6-month scope and list three measurable signals we'll track together."

Jules: Would be great to have a 2-sentence promotion evidence starter too (for managers writing up recommendations).

Lina: Draft: "[Name] delivered measurable product improvements (cite metrics/PRs). They have demonstrated scope beyond current level by owning cross-team strategy and mentoring peers; recommend promotion discussion."

Priya: Perfect. Can you also add a short privacy-safe example that managers can copy (no customer names)? Helps people see formatting.

Lina: Example below (privacy-safe):
"Eli improved model serving latency by 15% (perf-dashboard) and reduced infra spend by 9% (cost-report). They led the rollout plan across three squads; recommend expanding their scope to cross-product reliability."

Lina: Final note: keep everything <300 words for IC full narratives; managers stick to 3 bullets + 1-line summary for calibration.

HRbot: Reminder (automated): Review window opens in 2 days. People Ops office hours: Thursday 13:00-15:00. Use #people-ops-help for quick Qs.

Ravi: Great work — I'll paste these into the template doc and tag folks for feedback.

Lina: Thanks! Tag me for edits and I'll curate examples from past cycles.

Priya: Appreciated — saves so much time.

Jules: Cheers :clap:
